artifacts.summary: The offered-concurrency-8 control failed its predeclared 100% strict/canary gate. Request 15 returned a complete HTTP response with finish=stop but omitted its own marker and emitted 3 requested code words plus 150 extra words. This is a genuine model response-contract failure for this offered-C8 population, not a missing-response or scorer-observability failure.

Stop the entire dependent C8 comparison now. Do not load C8, retry seed2801, substitute another seed, or compute a partial comparison. The frozen arm required 100% strict/canary compliance and both reserved pairs eligible; the general estimator says any failed cell stops dependent comparisons.

This out-of-envelope offered-C8 failure does not by itself disqualify the unchanged b2048/C4 production recipe. The required production capacity gate is C4, and the optional optimization plan separates final C4 qualification from the concurrency axis. Continued exact-C4 agentic 18/18, SWE >=3/5, images, natural/64K diagnostics, routed policy, and real-client gates is defensible only after retaining this scope ruling. Promotion remains blocked until every applicable original gate passes.

The evidence does not support attributing the semantic miss to overload, runtime failure, or cache leakage. Identity was stable; the owner remained running; OOM and kernel fault counters were zero; all requests received HTTP 200. Zero foreign markers only refutes observed cross-request marker leakage in this sample. Logs show 4 running and 4 waiting under offered8/max-seqs4, but that scheduling fact is not causal proof.

The cgroup peak equals its configured limit and memory.events.max is nonzero, so resource pressure cannot be excluded; these counters are cumulative and do not establish that pressure caused request 15. Retain this limitation without causal wording.

A C4 promotion is supportable only if routed admission is independently shown to enforce the declared production max_concurrency4 and no publication or harness claims support for offered concurrency8 or max concurrency8. The direct offered8 observation must remain a disclosed failed diagnostic.
